_about: Public-domain Richard Meux Benson (1824-1915, founder of the Society of St John the Evangelist, Cowley) for the Word Hoard: 9 volumes from Internet Archive scans: Redemption (1861), The Final Passover (vols I-III in five books, 1893-1895, with The Life beyond the Grave, 1885, as its fourth volume), Benedictus Dominus (no year on the title page) and The Followers of the Lamb (1905 impression). Written in English. Not Robert Hugh Benson, who has his own shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 28 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
